# National Whistleblower Lawyer

> > Legal resource for whistleblowers reporting fraud under the False Claims Act, SEC Whistleblower Program, and California Insurance Fraud Prevention Act.

National Whistleblower Lawyer provides comprehensive information about qui tam cases, whistleblower protections, and fraud reporting across healthcare, government contracting, securities, and insurance sectors. The site offers confidential legal representation and detailed case examples to help potential whistleblowers understand their rights and the process of reporting fraud to the Department of Justice and SEC.

## Key Topics

- False Claims Act
- Qui Tam Cases
- SEC Whistleblower Program
- Healthcare Fraud
- California Insurance Fraud Prevention Act (CIFPA)
- Anti-Kickback Statute
- Government Contracting Fraud
- Pharmaceutical Fraud
- Medicare and Medicaid Fraud
- Securities Fraud
- Department of Justice
- Whistleblower Awards
- State False Claims Acts
- Insurance Fraud
- Fraud Reporting

## Get Started

- [Report Fraud Now](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/report-fraud-now): Confidential fraud reporting with free legal services and guidance
- [Whistleblower Attorney](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/about-us-national-whistleblower-lawyer/whistleblower-attorney): Experienced whistleblower attorneys offering confidential representation
- [Whistleblower Areas](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/whistleblower-areas): Overview of whistleblower statutes including False Claims Act & SEC programs

## Filing a Qui Tam Case

- [How Do I File a Qui Tam Case?](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/whistleblower-information/how-do-i-file-a-qui-tam-case): Step-by-step guide to filing a qui tam case under False Claims Act
- [What Do I Want in a Qui Tam Lawyer?](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/whistleblower-information/what-do-i-want-in-a-qui-tam-lawyer): Guide to selecting a qualified qui tam attorney for False Claims Act cases
- [False Claims Act Statute of Limitations](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/false-claims-act-statute-of-limitations): DOJ brief on Supreme Court case regarding 6-10 year FCA limitations period

## Successful Case Examples by Industry

- [Examples of Successful Qui Tam Cases By Industry](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/examples-of-successful-qui-tam-cases-by-industry): Industry-organized qui tam case examples with settlement outcomes
- [Pharmaceutical Fraud Cases](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/successful-qui-tam-cases-against-pharmaceutical-companies-off-label-marketing): Qui tam settlement examples for pharmaceutical fraud & off-label marketing
- [Bank Fraud Cases](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/successful-qui-tam-cases-report-bank-fraud): Post-bailout bank fraud qui tam case examples and settlements
- [Government Contracting Qui Tam](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/whistleblower-areas/false-claims-act/government-contracting-qui-tam): False Claims Act qui tam cases for government contractor fraud

## Whistleblower Programs & Statutes

- [California Insurance Fraud Prevention Act](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/whistleblower-areas/california-insurance-fraud-prevention-act-california-qui-tam): CIFPA qui tam law for private insurer fraud with whistleblower rewards
- [Report Fraud on Private Insurance Companies](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/report-fraud-private-insurance-companies): CIFPA qui tam cases for private insurance fraud with whistleblower awards
- [What is the Anti-Kickback Statute?](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/what-is-the-anti-kickback-statute): Anti-Kickback Statute overview and False Claims Act case examples

## SEC Whistleblower Program

- [SEC Whistleblower Awards Distributed](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/sec-whistlebower-awards-distributed): List of SEC whistleblower program awards and distributions
- [SEC Whistleblower Award Trend](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/sec-whistleblower-award-trend): SEC whistleblower award trends and statistical analysis

## Recent Cases & News

- [Blog](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/blog): Updates on qui tam and whistleblower cases nationwide
- [Medstar Health $35 Million Kickback Settlement](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/medstar-health-35-million-whistleblower-kickback-settlement): DOJ $35M kickback settlement with Medstar Health for cardiology referrals
- [Whistleblower Award: Ambulance Fraud](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/whistleblower-award-for-qui-tam-case-ambulance-fraud): AmeriCare ambulance fraud settlement for medically unnecessary services
- [Inflated IT Subcontract Costs Case](https://nationalwhistleblowerlawyer.org/false-claims-act-case-for-inflated-information-technology-subcontract-costs): DOJ lawsuit against Lockheed Martin for inflated IT subcontract costs
